notes.title: Lifetime Supportpatch
notes.notes:
Hey guys, after a long run on the preview branch we finally have the adjustments for the maximum number of items live. So now you can set how many grenades and Molotovs your teammates can buy at the beginning.

Additionally we made some runtime adjustments to keep the communication with the Twitch servers up and running.

[b]Unfortunately we also have some bad news:[/b]
Unfortunately, we are forced to disable the in-game highscore for privacy reasons. So no new highscores will be sent to our servers anymore. Existing scores will be deleted in the coming days.

notes.title: Molotovs are here!
notes.notes:
Give your enemies hell, with the new molotov equipment. buy one during the preperation phase and throw it on the field.
Molotovs will burn for 20 seconds and do damage over time to all enemies stepping into the fire.

notes.title: Feature update 1.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Turn up the speakers, from now on there's something for your ears![/h3]
For all our fans who stream Avatar Raiders as the main game, there are now in-game sound effects.
Just activate the sound in the settings on the new menu item: [b]AUDIO[/b].

[h3]New Twitch authentication[/h3]
Some of you had problems with the existing authentication on Twitch. We have taken care of this problem and have completely re-integrated the login. From now on we use our own Twitch authentication.
After the update, you will have to link your login data to Twitch again.
To do this, go to the settings under [b]CHAT[/b] and link Avatar Raiders with your Twitch account.

This will allow us to offer you many more features in the future. Be curious what is still to come.

[b]Global changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Twitch authentication. 
[*] Audio can now be enabled in-game if desired.
[*]The game characters have been enlarged a bit to improve visibility.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]There was a rare bug where, depending on the computer's processing power, some characters fired more shots than they were supposed to in that time. This problem has been fixed.
[*] Sometimes a game was displayed as a victory, although not all zombies had been finally killed. This problem has also been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Connection Hotfix
notes.notes: We have received reports that it is not possible to connect to Twitch servers in North America.  We were able to identify an issue with the connection and have provided a hotfix. After a restart of you should be able to install the update.

notes.title: Stream Deck Integration
notes.notes:
You wanted to control Avatar Raiders comfortably with your stream deck. We have listened.
From now on you will find a Stream Deck Plugin in your Avatar Raiders installation folder that will make this possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41897246/7e4971ee37916791c0a8e5498c65fece65203568.png[/img]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[b]1. Stream Deck Plugin:[/b]
You can now control Avatar Raiders with your Stream Deck. You can find the plugin in the installation folder of Avatar Raiders. Allow remote access under Controls in the settings and set a TCP-Port and a password.
Store this data in the Stream Deck plugin as well.
[b]2. Equipment aliases;[/b]
You can now set an alias for the equipment in the chat settings. Your viewers can then use the existing command as well as the alias you defined to buy or throw grenades.
[b]3. Round start via chat command:[/b]
If you wish, you can define a chat command in the chat settings with which you and your moderators can skip the cool-down and immediately start a preparation phase.
